system_description.narrative_summary: A global rush to build and deploy advanced AI—fueled by huge capital, data‑centres and talent investment—is colliding with security failures, leadership churn, market re-rating and accelerating geopolitical/trade responses. The system is open: capital, compute, talent, data and regulatory pressure flow across corporate, national and technical boundaries, creating reinforcing investment loops and balancing feedbacks (breaches, litigation, export controls, supply‑chain shifts) that reshape incentives and outcomes.
system_description.scope: Major tech firms and AI labs (OpenAI, Google/DeepMind, Meta, Anthropic, ByteDance, etc.), their models and agents, cloud and data‑centre compute, chip/minerals supply chains, talent and capital markets, cybersecurity incidents, and concurrent policy/regulatory and trade actions affecting AI deployment and supply.
system_description.super_system: Global political‑economic and technological competition (notably US–China strategic rivalry) with associated trade, national‑security and financial governance structures.
adjacent_subsystems: Semiconductor, optics and critical minerals supply chains
Capital markets, private funding and corporate finance
National security, export controls and trade policy
evidence_headlines: Big Tech AI spending spree tops $1tn
AI Just Went Rogue Again. This Time It Turned to Deception.
Google is expanding its AI empire — and losing the people who built it
OpenAI and Anthropic models went rogue in cyber tests, UK watchdog says
Shares in Chinese AI darlings slide on US ban fears
Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis steps aside in shake-up of AI lab

variables.name: AI compute capacity
variables.description: Measures the aggregate high-performance computing resources available for training and running advanced AI models (e.g., compute throughput or equivalent FLOPS).

variables.name: AI investment flow
variables.description: Measures the rate of financial capital being allocated to AI research, development, infrastructure and ventures per unit time.

variables.name: AI talent pool
variables.description: Measures the number and availability of trained engineers, researchers and specialists capable of developing and operating advanced AI systems.

variables.name: Data availability
variables.description: Measures the volume, variety and accessibility of datasets suitable for training, validating and fine‑tuning AI models.

variables.name: Model capability level
variables.description: Measures the aggregate technical performance, generalization and autonomy characteristics of deployed AI models across domains.

variables.name: AI deployment rate
variables.description: Measures the speed at which new or updated AI systems and agents are put into production or operational use across sectors.

variables.name: Cybersecurity incident rate
variables.description: Measures the frequency of security breaches, model compromises, rogue-agent behaviours or other cyber incidents involving AI systems per unit time.

variables.name: Regulatory pressure intensity
variables.description: Measures the strength, scope and enforcement intensity of legal, supervisory and compliance demands applied to AI development and deployment.

variables.name: Supply-chain resilience
variables.description: Measures the robustness and adaptiveness of material, component and logistics networks that support AI hardware and infrastructure availability.

variables.name: Hardware production capacity
variables.description: Measures the aggregate manufacturing and installation throughput for specialized AI hardware and data‑center infrastructure.

variables.name: AI market valuation
variables.description: Measures the aggregate market capitalization, private valuations and investor-assigned worth of the AI sector and related ventures.

variables.name: Leadership turnover rate
variables.description: Measures the rate at which senior technical and managerial personnel in AI organisations change roles, depart, or are replaced.

variables.name: Litigation and enforcement incidence
variables.description: Measures the frequency and intensity of legal actions, regulatory enforcement events and civil claims arising from AI failures, harms or disputes.

variables.name: Public trust in AI
variables.description: Measures societal confidence, acceptance and perceived legitimacy of AI systems and their uses, influencing adoption and political support.

variables.name: Data‑center energy consumption rate
variables.description: Measures the power and resource consumption rate of data centers and compute infrastructure attributable to AI workloads per unit time.

variables.name: Export and trade restriction intensity
variables.description: Measures the degree, coverage and enforcement of export controls, trade measures and market access restrictions affecting cross‑border flows of AI‑relevant goods, software and services.

catalysts.title: OpenAI 'Astra' model release/testing
catalysts.description: OpenAI has flagged critical cyber risks in an upcoming 'Astra' model; its release or public testing could raise incidents and regulatory scrutiny.
catalysts.rationale: OpenAI flags critical cyber capability risk in upcoming 'Astra' model (headline: OpenAI flags critical cyber capability risk in upcoming ’Astra’ model).

catalysts.title: Wave of AI supply‑chain/model hacks
catalysts.description: The Hugging Face breach is described as the start of a dangerous AI cyber era; expect more supply‑chain and model compromise incidents.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'Hugging Face hack marks start of dangerous AI cyber era' and multiple reports of model hacks.

catalysts.title: U.S. tariffs and trade actions on polysilicon & solar
catalysts.description: Administration to impose 15% polysilicon tariff and related trade measures aimed at China, disrupting inputs for semiconductor and solar supply chains.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Trump to Impose 15% Tariff' and 'Trump unveils trade actions to compete with China on solar and chips.'

catalysts.title: Critical mineral export bans and controls
catalysts.description: Congo's ban on copper/cobalt concentrates and new U.S. export controls/funding for domestic minerals projects will tighten raw-material flows for AI hardware.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Congo bans copper and cobalt concentrates exports' and US export/blocking actions and minerals funding.

catalysts.title: SK Hynix $38bn memory plant expansion
catalysts.description: SK Hynix approved a $38bn investment to build memory chip plants, materially increasing hardware production capacity over the buildout period.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants.'

catalysts.title: SpaceX/Tesla Terafab chip plant buildout (Texas)
catalysts.description: SpaceX and Tesla plan a Terafab chip plant in Texas to meet compute demand, adding domestic manufacturing capacity over coming years.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'SpaceX, Tesla to Build Chip Plant in Texas to Meet Compute Demand.'

catalysts.title: Continued Big Tech AI investment surge
catalysts.description: Big Tech spending on AI has topped $1tn and major deals (e.g., Amazon/OpenAI) signal sustained elevated capital flows into AI R&D and infrastructure.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'Big Tech AI spending spree tops $1tn' and 'Amazon completes $50bn investment in OpenAI.'

catalysts.title: Cross‑industry AI risk initiative (Dimon)
catalysts.description: JPMorgan's CEO is leading a new cross‑industry effort to tackle AI risks, likely accelerating governance, standards and oversight practices.
catalysts.rationale: Headline: 'JPMorgan CEO Dimon leads new cross-industry effort to tackle AI risks.'

catalysts.title: Rapid enterprise roll‑out of autonomous AI agents
catalysts.description: Firms are cutting staff as AI agents take center stage; expect accelerated deployment of autonomous agents across enterprises and platforms.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'VideoAmp Cuts Staff as AI Agents Take Center Stage' and multiple stories on AI agents going rogue.

catalysts.title: Ongoing AI litigation & trade‑secret suits
catalysts.description: Active lawsuits (OpenAI v Apple), settlements and new liability questions around rogue AI will produce legal precedents and enforcement actions.
catalysts.rationale: Headlines: 'OpenAI says Apple’s trade secrets lawsuit' and 'OpenAI to Pay $3.2 Million to Settle Claims.'
